title: 第7章仙路漫长这一脚老夫记下了第8章竟是塑婴丹
slug: 凡人修仙疯了吧你一百岁了还要修仙

晨光渐盛，虽是白天，但废丹院还是一如既往的死寂。
北寒风盘坐在石床上，当这个月的第十枚极品练气丹的灵气在他体内被彻底炼化，下丹田内的气海旋骤然膨胀，旋转的速度加快，气海内的灵气被压缩的更凝实纯重！
一股远超炼气四层的强横气息猛然从北寒风身上发出，随后被他体内运转的《龟息蕴灵诀》慢慢磨息，最后归于平静。
炼气六层！
北寒风缓缓吐出一口长气，只觉力量充盈四肢百骸，一种掌握自身命运的踏实感涌上心头。
百年岁月空付，直至此时，方于这仙门之中，望见一缕长生的微光。
就在北寒打算继续稳定一下境界时，院内突然传来一阵嘈杂的脚步声。
紧接着小屋门被粗鲁地踢开，三个穿着外门弟子服饰的青年走了进来。
为首一人面色倨傲，三角眼扫过简单的屋内，最后落在北寒风身上。
“喂，老东西。”三角眼弟子抬着下巴，“听说你这废丹院里，偶尔还能捡到没完全废透的丹药？”
北寒风起身站在床边，浑浊的眼睛看向他，双手抱拳微微行了一礼，“这位师兄说笑了，都是些宗门废弃之物，灵气早散尽了。”
“少废话！”旁边一个矮胖弟子不耐烦地挥手，“王师兄炼丹正缺一味辅药，听说前阵子有批炼废的‘赤阳草’渣子倒在这里了，带我们去废丹房找找！”
北寒风抱拳的双手紧了紧，现在的废丹房可以说是他的禁脔，里面那些还可以被红皮葫芦转化的废丹，更是他命根子。
“师兄，”他声音沙哑，带着为难，“里面丹毒混杂，气味污浊，恐污了各位师兄法体……”
“让你带路就带路！”三角眼王师兄眼神一厉，一股炼气五层的气息隐隐压来，“一个看守废丹房的老废物，也敢拦我？”
北寒风垂下眼睑，掩住眸底一丝冷光。他慢慢直起腰，侧身让开道路，“师兄请。”
一行人来到废丹房门外，推开废丹房厚重的木门，一股混杂着焦糊与霉变的气味扑面而来。
矮胖弟子嫌恶地捂住鼻子，“什么鬼地方！”
王师兄目光在堆积如山的废丹残渣中扫过，眉头紧锁。他确实需要赤阳草残渣作为药引，但此地杂乱不堪，盲目的寻找无异于大海捞针。

“你们，去那边翻翻！”他指挥着两个跟班，自己则走到一堆颜色深褐的丹药残渣前，用脚踢了踢。
北寒风默默跟在后面，看着他们粗暴地翻找，将一些勉强成型的丹药随意踢开，心下沉冷。
这些在他眼中可皆是未来修为提升的资粮。
“王师兄，没有啊！”矮胖弟子抱怨道，“都是些没用的垃圾！”
王师兄脸色难看，目光忽然落在墙角一个不起眼的麻袋上。那袋子鼓鼓囊囊，口子扎得严实。“那是什么？”
北寒风心头一跳。那里面是他近期分拣出来、尚未放入葫芦的废丹，约莫数百颗。
“只是一些清理出来的废渣，准备日后统一处理的。”北寒风上前一步，挡在麻袋前。
王师兄眯起眼，怀疑地盯着他，“打开看看。”
“师兄，皆是无用之物……”
“我让你打开！”王师兄厉喝一声，目光恨恨地看着北寒风。
北寒风沉默片刻，弯下腰，枯瘦的手指缓缓解着麻袋系绳。

The morning light is getting stronger, and although it is daytime, the Waste Pill Courtyard is still as dead as ever.
Bei Hanfeng sat cross-legged on the stone bed. When the spiritual energy of this month's tenth top quality Qi training pill was completely refined in his body, the air vortex in the lower Dantian suddenly expanded, the rotation speed accelerated, and the spiritual energy in the air sea was compressed to become more solid and pure!
A powerful aura that far exceeded the fourth level of Qi Refining suddenly emitted from Bei Hanfeng, and was slowly exhaled by the "Turtle Breath Yunling Jue" running in his body, and finally returned to calm.
Sixth level of Qi refining!
Beihanfeng slowly exhaled a long breath, and felt power filling his limbs, and a sense of security that he was in control of his own destiny came to his heart.
Hundreds of years have passed in vain, until now, Fang saw a glimmer of immortality in this fairy gate.
Just when Beihan was about to stabilize his realm, there was suddenly a burst of noisy footsteps in the courtyard.
Immediately afterwards, the door of the hut was kicked open rudely, and three young men wearing the clothes of outer disciples walked in.
The leader looked arrogant, his triangular eyes swept across the simple room, and finally landed on Bei Hanfeng.
"Hey, old man." The triangle-eyed disciple raised his chin, "I heard that in your waste elixir courtyard, you can occasionally pick up incomplete elixirs?"
Bei Hanfeng stood up and stood beside the bed. He looked at him with cloudy eyes and bowed slightly with his hands clasped in his fists. "This senior brother is joking. They are all discarded items from the sect. Their spiritual energy has long since dissipated."
"Stop talking nonsense!" A short, fat disciple next to him waved his hand impatiently, "Senior Brother Wang is short of an auxiliary medicine in his alchemy. I heard that a batch of waste 'Red Sun Grass' residue was dumped here a while ago. Take us to the waste elixir room to look for it!"
Bei Hanfeng tightened his fists. The current waste elixir room could be said to be his forbidden treasure, and the waste elixirs inside that could be transformed by red-skinned gourds were his lifeblood.
"Senior brother," his voice was hoarse and embarrassed, "it's mixed with erysipelas and has a foul smell. I'm afraid it will contaminate the body of all senior brothers..."
"Lead the way if I ask you to!" Senior Brother Triangle-Eyed King's eyes stern, and a breath of the fifth level of Qi Refining faintly pressed down, "An old loser guarding the useless alchemy room, dare to stop me?"
Beihanfeng lowered his eyelids, hiding a cold light in his eyes. He slowly straightened up and stepped aside to get out of the way, "Senior brother, please."
The group of people came to the door of the waste elixir room, pushed open the heavy wooden door of the waste elixir room, and felt a smell of burnt and mildew mixed with it.
The short and fat disciple covered his nose in disgust, "What the hell is this place!"
Senior Brother Wang glanced at the mountains of waste elixir residue, his brows furrowed. He really needed the residue of red sun grass as a medicine guide, but the place was so messy that blindly searching for it was like looking for a needle in a haystack.
"You guys, go over there and look around!" He directed his two followers, while he walked to a pile of dark brown pill residue and kicked it with his feet.
Bei Hanfeng followed silently, watching them rummaging roughly and randomly kicking away some barely formed elixirs, and felt a chill in his heart.
In his eyes, these are all materials for future cultivation improvement.
"Senior Brother Wang, there are none!" the short and fat disciple complained, "They are all useless garbage!"
Senior Brother Wang's face was ugly, and his eyes suddenly fell on an inconspicuous sack in the corner. The bag was bulging and the opening was tightly tied. "What's that?"
Bei Hanfeng's heart skipped a beat. Inside were some hundreds of waste pills that he had recently sorted out but had not yet been put into the gourd.
"It's just some cleaned up waste that will be disposed of in a unified way in the future." Bei Hanfeng took a step forward and stood in front of the sack.
Senior Brother Wang narrowed his eyes and stared at him suspiciously, "Open it and take a look."
"Brother, they are all useless..."
"I told you to open it!" Senior Brother Wang shouted sharply, looking at Bei Hanfeng with hatred.
Bei Hanfeng was silent for a moment, bent down, and slowly loosened the rope of the sack with his skinny fingers.
